Subject: Re: [oss-security] CVE-2099-12345 AcmeDocs template injection

> On Tue, someone wrote:
> AcmeDocs 4.2.3 is vulnerable, can anyone confirm the root cause?

Confirmed. The root cause is in TemplateRenderer.resolveHint(), which passes the raw X-Template-Hint header to the expression evaluator. There is no allow-list check on the header value in 4.2.3 and earlier.

    curl -H 'X-Template-Hint: ${7*7}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/preview

The fix in 4.2.4 restricts hint values to a fixed set of template names.
